title: Sustainable metal recovery from waste printed circuit boards through citric acid leaching using response surface methodology and predictive modelling
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9757-9768
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08576D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Syed Suffia Iqbal, Ovais Iqbal Shah, Deblina Dutta
Sustainable metal recovery from waste mobile phone printed circuit boards was achieved using green citric acid leaching optimized by experimental design and machine learning, improving recovery efficiency and supporting circular economy goals.
